contexts.text: To be troubled in spirit = to be disturbed. Explained.
Thou shalt wave them a waving before Jehovah = Divine life thence... To wave a waving = to vivify, thus life. Illustrated.
To be waved by the priest = to be vivified to receive blessing, for all blessing must have life from the Divine in it in order to be blessing.
To wave a waving = to vivify through acknowledgement, which is the first of life from the Divine.
To wave a waving of gold to Jehovah = to vivify through the acknowledgement that it was... the Lord's.
The reason why to wave a waving = such things, is from correspondence, for all motion corresponds to state of thought.

Thou shalt wave it a waving before Jehovah = vivification... To wave a waving before Jehovah = vivification through acknowledgement of the Lord, and that He has all power in the Heavens and on earth. AC 10093. Explained.
The motion or agitation of the blood. WE 2343 et seq.
